name: @photo-archive/importer
description: Node CLI for bulk Google Takeout import: metadata repair, hashing, derivatives, embeddings, upload, verification, manifest. Bulk ingest must not depend on the mobile device (Req 12.7).
//bin: Declared once the CLI entry point exists (phase 2). A bin pointing at an unbuilt file breaks install.

scripts.//fixtures: Materializes the Takeout fixture corpus into a directory so a pairing failure can be inspected on disk. The tests build it into a temp dir instead.
